theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_smooth_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F G : Euclid N → Euclid N') (H : Euclid (N + 1) → Euclid N') (K : Set (Euclid N)), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ G → IsCompact K → (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, H (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) = F x + t • (G x - F x)) → ∃ (Fs Gs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N') (Hs : ℕ → Euclid (N + 1) → Euclid N') (Λ' : ℝ), (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Fs j)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Gs j)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Hs j)) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N), ‖fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x‖ ≤ (Λ : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N), ‖fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x‖ ≤ (Λ : ℝ)) ∧ TendstoUniformly Fs F atTop ∧ TendstoUniformly Gs G atTop ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N), Hs j (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) = Gs j x) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N), Hs j (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) = Fs j x) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (x v : Euclid N), fderiv ℝ (Hs j) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v))) = fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x v) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (x v : Euclid N), fderiv ℝ (Hs j) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v))) = fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x v) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), ‖fderiv ℝ (Hs j) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)‖ ≤ dist (F x) (G x) + 2 * (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x v : Euclid N), ‖fderiv ℝ (Hs j) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)))‖ ≤ (Λ : ℝ) * ‖v‖) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ‖fderiv ℝ (Hs j) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)))‖ ≤ Λ') ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn Hs H atTop {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ K, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))}
